name: CISA (Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency)
description: U.S. national coordinator for critical infrastructure cybersecurity. Maintains the KEV Catalog, issues Binding Operational Directives, and operates the Cyber Safety Review Board.

peerReview.processDescription: KEV Catalog: Intelligence aggregation, Validation through multiple sources, Vendor coordination, Public nomination. BODs: Federal agencies must comply with directives undergoing interagency review. CSRB: Independent review body modeled on NTSB.

attribution.attributionNotes: KEV entries carry federal authority. CISA certifications and assessments recognized across U.S. critical infrastructure sectors.

povsAlignment.description: Government cybersecurity coordinator with federal authority for vulnerability validation.
